params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a polished stylized 3D action-adventure game set in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul, Korea, inside a small real-life interior. SETTING: a Korean high-school classroom of class 2-3 on the first morning of the school year, 8:23 am, seen from the open rear sliding door. About 9 by 8 meters: six columns by five rows of single student desks with light wood tops on grey steel frames and matching chairs; about twenty-five students in black blazers, white shirts and dark ties sit at the desks, several turning around in their seats to look back at the door; at the front a big dark green chalkboard with a few illegible chalk scribbles, a wooden teacher's lectern and a young male teacher in a beige cardigan; a wall clock and a small speaker above the board; tall aluminium windows along the left wall with cream curtains half drawn, showing the old grey granite Seoul fortress wall and pine trees on the hill outside in bright morning light; a row of grey steel cubby lockers along the back wall under a cork bulletin board with blank colored papers; fluorescent ceiling lights; a mop and bucket in the corner. The player character stands in the rear doorway in a black school blazer, seen from behind. Clean bright spring morning light. RENDERING STYLE: cel-shaded 3D that reads like a flat-colored anime background painting. Every surface is a flat color area with exactly one crisp shadow tone (a warm grey multiply of the base color, never black or muddy), thin warm-black ink outlines (#1A1417) on silhouettes, frames, furniture and object edges; outlines get thinner with distance. No gradients on walls, no photographic textures, no realistic dirt: materials are suggested only by sparse hand-drawn marks (a few ink dots, short hatching strokes, tile seams, wood grain lines). Muted low-saturation palette, subtle paper grain over the whole image, gentle split toning. Shapes are clean and readable like a real-time 3D game built from modular pieces, yet rich in lived-in props. CAMERA: third-person game camera, lens height about 1.6 m, 35 mm lens, natural eye-level perspective, the whole room readable. The reference image shows the player character (a lanky 17-year-old Korean boy with curly black hair): draw him small, standing in the lower left third and filling about one third of the image height. No HUD, no UI, no watermark. Posters, boards, menus and labels are simple blocks of color or tiny illegible scribbles: absolutely no readable letters, no Korean or English text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks anywhere. No alcohol, no cigarettes.
